label: Warrant for the possible absence of a foundational simple being: PGP versus non-power accounts
summary: Issue #1887 tests 1-3, the assessment slice; tests 4-5 are a parallel formal slice. Note docs/notes/foundational-absence-warrant.md, repaired after an independent semantic challenge of head d101db48 (acceptable after listed repairs: 5 P1, 12 P2; all accepted; disposition table in the note). Prose only: no statement, argument, result, definition, Lean or source-claim change. Analyst formulations, attribution deferred; references are marked read (URL, date, section) or navigation only. Fixed meanings: the candidate n is first (74eb9113, with B3 ee74c678) and simple in the route's sense (78246da5: no matter-form composition, esse = essence). 'Could be absent' means ContingentAt: S2 at n, the denial of n's NECESSARY_2 necessity; it does not by itself deny the existential node b19ffd92, whose incompatibility with S2 is 6b12525b. Test 1, evidence for the possibility itself. (a) Subtraction: SEP Nothingness s.7 (read) offers only the temporal analogy 'What can be done temporally can be done modally', which at n reduces to conceivability or to actual temporal absence; it fails criterion 3. (b) Conceivability is a substantive objection, with independent support from the general conceivability-possibility link, and a contested non-generalization reply. The prima facie datum is not symmetric: Aquinas grants C(not E n) (ST I q.2 a.1 sed contra, read); Hume denies C(box E n) as meaningless (Dialogues IX, as quoted by Van Cleve s.2, read). The bundle {StrongBridge, C(box E n), C(not E n), Euclidean frame} is inconsistent but does not select its culprit. Euclideanness is not a route premise (6f7a4ccc, d9db5ed8), and on S4 the bundle is satisfiable. The reply rests on three things: secondary conceivability of n's absence would need knowledge of n's nature (the SEP s.4.1 water/H2O case, read; van Inwagen as reported in SEP s.3); an analyst empiricist calibration premise, which equally removes conceivability support for the contingency of the universe in other routes (a shared dependency); and descriptive identification of n. Arnauld's triangle (Van Cleve s.3) is used only against double-occurrence conceivings, per Descartes's reply. (c) Actual temporal absence is a genuine datum type, not instantiated. Symmetrically, PGP has no case datum. Actualist grounding separates PGP only from primitivism (essences ground absence for the essentialist, and actual objects do for Armstrong, as reported in SEP s.7). Powers epistemology gives agnosticism; the experiential motivation concerns change-powers. Test 2, the hybrid. ST I q.45 a.2 ad 2 and a.3 (read): creation is not change because change needs a subject, and the subject of substantial change is matter. But q.9 a.2 (read) grounds creatures' possibility of existence in divine power, and q.104 a.3 ad 1 and ad 3 (read) treats annihilation as a cessation of action, non-existence having no direct cause. So 'existence is not a change' bounds passive-potency and change-power grounding, not power-grounding as such. The hybrid keeps POTENCY_1, motion as reduction and the act principle (the R2 law; bruteSimple). It must count actual generation and corruption as power exercises and accept the typed PGP disjunction for corruptibles (trivially, through CanFailToBe). It is not forced to power-ground their cross-world contingency. It undercuts PGP's motivation, though not its verdict, at subjectless existence, and supplies no verdict of its own at n. Test 3, costs, using the 542c595e-style extra-content test for every view. Primitivism gives no verdict at n. Unrestricted combinatorialism's extra content (542c595e) is not motivated by Hume's dictum. Van Cleve (read, ss.2, 3, 10): one of Hume's two mistakes enters the derivation of Real Separability; the standalone intuition concerns dependence. That does not reach trivial co-necessitation by a necessary n, but the dictum's dependence intuition, including the strengthening Van Cleve's s.10 summary reports, is recorded as an open consideration against the route's dependence premises (B2 8a8d00e9, B3). EC: SEP's criticisms (s.1.1 and s.3, read) target the existence-conditioned modal characterization, so carrying them over to essence-first EC is an analyst step, and their cost (necessary numbers) is avoided by concreta-restricted EC, the matching-scope rival. That rival's concrete/abstract cut has no identified independent motivation at n. The idleness of esse = essence is the statement of the B6 crux (96971e31 brute-first model), not a cost. Unconditional essentialism gives a second route to necessity, correlated with B6 through simplicity. PGP's substantive content is its completeness over incorruptibles (PGP holds trivially for corruptibles), and that content has no n-specific motivation independent of theism; the sourced instances read (q.9 a.2 for all creatures; q.104 a.3) presuppose a creator, and Pruss's combined account derives one only from that same completeness. PGP's 'unexplained lack of power' adds no cost beyond the open premises 16c760a3, 9163c423 and b62a64ab; the defaults are matched. Withdrawn from the first draft: 'qualified relative standing' for PGP at n; conceivability 'failing criterion 3'; Arnauld as support for single-occurrence conceivings; the claim that the hybrid must power-ground corruptibles' existence possibilities; 8bfc4ab7 in F2; EC's idleness as a cost. Computed frontier delta: none.
blocker: The disagreement at n sits in the general theories' extra content at subjectless existence: PGP's completeness over incorruptibles, concreta-restricted EC's concrete/abstract cut, and unrestricted recombination. None has an identified n-specific motivation. Conceivability remains unresolved; its reply depends on an analyst calibration premise shared with other routes. Also open: a Kant-type thesis applied to an identity of esse and essence; 16c760a3, 9163c423 and b62a64ab; Vetter's own text; the strengthened Hume's dictum against B2; Pruss's joint-contingency premise (test 5). Requested formal results F1-F5 (note s.8): Euclidean conceivability parity with an S4 control; PGP's extra content as a certified difference with excluded middle as an explicit premise; an exposed lemma for the lack of power; unconditional essence on the B6 vocabulary; Hume's dictum with and without the necessary-being exemption.

current_assessment.scope: PGP 20d5fecd and S2 at the candidate necessary being (n's necessity; its node b19ffd92 excludes S2 at its world, 6b12525b), at the possible absence of a foundational simple uncaused actual individual (route meanings of firstness 74eb9113 and simplicity 78246da5). The general-theory comparison of modal accounts beyond this node is not in scope.
current_assessment.assessment: Parity at n: neither the claim that n could be absent nor PGP's verdict that n is necessary has discriminating warrant there. Subtraction does not discriminate (fails criterion 3). Unrestricted combinatorialism's extra content (542c595e), PGP's completeness over incorruptibles, and concreta-restricted existence-conditional essentialism's concrete/abstract cut each deliver their verdict at n from general-theory content with no identified n-specific motivation. Conceivability is a substantive objection to n's necessity with a contested non-generalization reply (secondary conceivability, an analyst calibration premise shared with other routes, descriptive identification); it is unresolved. Its inconsistency argument needs a Euclidean frame, which the route does not assume. No relative standing is claimed for PGP. That would require a defense of the actualist grounding demand excluding essence-based and recombinational grounds. The hybrid is principled as a boundary for passive potency and change-powers and compatible with the First Way's act/potency commitments; it undercuts PGP's motivation, not its verdict, at subjectless existence, and gives no verdict of its own at n. Restates the C2 note's s.13 judgment with the tests carried out at n. Nothing is established; no formal status changes.
current_assessment.next_test: Seek an independent motivation, or a defeat, for each general theory's extra content at subjectless existence: PGP's completeness over incorruptibles without a creator premise, concreta-restricted EC's cut, and unrestricted recombination. Also assess whether the actualist grounding demand can exclude non-power grounds of absence. In parallel, slice A's F1 (Euclidean parity with an S4 control) and F2 (PGP's extra content as a certified difference).
